question: How many tokens (and how much cost) has each work consumed?
sql: SELECT work_id, COUNT(*) AS turns, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS output_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost_usd), 0) AS total_cost_usd FROM "usage" GROUP BY work_id ORDER BY work_id
